purpose: Track coverage and gaps for the RTEC work-mail review without retaining personal mail, raw work mail, or person-level case details.
scope_boundary: This tracked file contains RTEC work-mail coverage only. Personal mailbox coverage and user-specific work history are maintained separately in a local-only private checkpoint. The user's RTEC start date is April 2026; pre-April company correspondence is organizational history and is not treated as the user's personal work history.

work.document_candidate_filter: Filename-only matches for blank, template, handbook, policy, procedure, manual, guide, form, or report; many hits belong to person-specific records and are not safe by filename alone.

incremental_review.safe_process_summary: Historical coordinator correspondence described position-dependent onboarding packets, driver-equivalent packets for Operations Area Managers, role-specific training for safety-sensitive Operations positions, and a Contractor PHI/Confidentiality Agreement stated to apply to everyone. These are unverified historical statements; the agreement was not attached.
incremental_review.unresolved_question: A proposed replacement of a prior court-record request form with Kentucky AOC-RU-004 was asked about, but approval or implementation is not documented.
incremental_review.excluded_content: No employee/applicant identities, personal training status, raw email bodies, or case details were retained.

incremental_review.source_type: two archived handbook-version emails with position-level attachments
incremental_review.safe_process_summary: The archive contains an earlier same-day DOCX and a later 48-page PDF with the same printed March 1, 2023 handbook date. The later email describes the PDF as revised and says to post it as the 2023 Employee Handbook. The complete version covers employment terms, pay and benefits, leave, attendance, harassment, dress and role-specific guidance, safety, confidentiality, discipline, communications, nepotism/fraternization, surveillance, EEO, and a blank handbook receipt certificate.
incremental_review.review_method: Both file hashes matched the attachment index. All 48 PDF pages were visually reviewed and text extracted. The DOCX's 690 main paragraphs were extracted; tracked edits and comments were absent. Text overlap was substantial but not exact, so both originals were retained as distinct versions.
incremental_review.authority_note: This is pre-April-2026 company history, not the user's personal work history. The source is historical; the complete December 2025 handbook is later and section-level supersession may apply.
incremental_review.excluded_content: No employee/applicant case records or person-level dossiers were created. Official names/signatures embedded in the handbook remain only within the position-level source allowed by the ingestion contract.

incremental_review.source_type: three archived employee-handbook attachment emails (two 2019 copies and one 2021 revised copy)
incremental_review.safe_process_summary: Two distinct DOCX copies printed July 15, 2019 were archived on Jan 2 and Jan 3, 2020; the Jan 3 position-level email requests website posting. A July 19, 2021 printed handbook was archived Oct 1, 2021, and its position-level email says it should replace the website copy. The 2021 document retains unresolved tracked revisions affecting leave and attendance, so those edits are not treated as adopted policy. Full original files and searchable redline/text mirrors are preserved.
incremental_review.review_method: Verified exact attachment hashes and source sizes; extracted all main-document text nodes and paragraph blocks; confirmed no comment parts and no 2019 tracked changes; compared the 2019 copies paragraph by paragraph; recorded 2021 tracked revision counts/authorship/date and policy subjects; preserved all three originals unchanged. Full clause-by-clause review remains in progress.
incremental_review.authority_note: All sources predate the user?s April 2026 start and are RTEC organizational history, not the user?s personal work history. No effective dates established; later complete handbook archives are preserved separately.
incremental_review.excluded_content: No raw email bodies, personal timeline facts, employee/applicant case records, or person-level dossiers were retained.

incremental_review.source_type: one historical handbook distribution email with a complete PDF attachment
incremental_review.safe_process_summary: HR correspondence dated 2022-09-19 identifies the attached July 19, 2021 printed handbook as the correct copy for the RTEC website. The 48-page PDF is distinct from the October 2021 tracked-change DOCX. Its metadata dates file creation before those later tracked edits, and visual/text review finds mixed attendance language; preserve the sources as conflicting historical evidence without deciding effective status.
incremental_review.review_method: Attachment size and SHA-256 matched the archive index; all 48 pages have extractable text; all-page contact sheets and selected relevant pages were visually reviewed. Full PDF text is mirrored page by page. Unrelated vacancy wording and signature/contact details from the email were not carried into the knowledge summary.
incremental_review.authority_note: Pre-April-2026 company history, not the user?s personal work history. Email supports a website-copy designation as of September 2022 but does not establish an effective date or resolve conflicts with the October 2021 DOCX.
incremental_review.excluded_content: No raw email body, staff vacancy record, employee/applicant case facts, or person-level dossier was retained.

incremental_review.source_type: historical HR correspondence with one-page handbook excerpt and time-and-attendance module discussion
incremental_review.safe_process_summary: A 2016 company-level correspondence thread records approval to proceed with a time-and-attendance module and includes a historical handbook page during vendor discussion. The page states a 90-day personal/sick-leave eligibility threshold; later 2019 and 2025 handbook sources state 30 days. This is a historical discrepancy, not a current rule.
incremental_review.authority_note: Pre-April-2026 company history, separate from the user's personal work history. The scanned page has an ambiguous 10/11 header, no established effective date, and only one page of a larger handbook.
incremental_review.excluded_content: No raw email body, contact names, personal timeline, employee/applicant case facts, or person-level dossier retained.

method_notes: The local work-mail index is read-only and caught up.
A deterministic lexical pass touched each indexed work message body to produce topic-discovery counts; these are overlapping search leads, not human semantic review or HR process metrics.
Messages without indexed bodies and all attachment content remain explicit review gaps.
Mailbox files, full message bodies, credentials, employee/applicant identities, and case narratives are excluded from this tracked record.

Local year-based attachment folders mix position-level references with restricted employee/applicant records; only exact, hash-verified organizational artifacts were opened for this batch. Broad folder contents were not copied or retained.
